description.value: The Burnaby Velodrome Club operates inside Harry Jerome Sports Centre as the only indoor velodrome in the Pacific Northwest and one of three indoor velodromes in Canada. The 200-metre wooden track — built between 1991 and 1997 — offers programs ranging from introductory 'Learn to Ride' sessions to competitive UCI-regulated racing, and the club maintains an explicit out-of-town rider policy along with private track bookings and bike rentals. It is a Cycling Canada Training Centre and has contributed significantly to Canada's track cycling development at the international level.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active velodrome club operating inside Harry Jerome Sports Centre — described as the only indoor velodrome in the Pacific Northwest — with programs for all skill levels and an explicit out-of-town rider policy, supporting an 'include' verdict. No specific amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving all criteria null. Two discrepancies were noted: OSM lists the street as 'Barnet Road' while the website footer consistently reads '7564 Barnet Highway,' and OSM assigns the record to 'North Vancouver' community while the website and postal address place it in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM name 'Harry Jerome Sports Centre' refers to the host building; the operator and all web presence is 'Burnaby Velodrome Club' — the WWC directory listing may benefit from referencing the velodrome name more prominently.
Address discrepancy: OSM lists '7564 Barnet Road' but the website footer consistently shows '7564 Barnet Highway, Burnaby, British Columbia V5A 1E7'.
OSM community field is set to 'North Vancouver' but the facility is located in Burnaby per the website and postal address.
No phone number is present in OSM or on the website contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is the only indoor velodrome in the Pacific Northwest with an explicit out-of-town rider policy, bike rentals, and introductory programs — a genuinely compelling cycling attraction for touring cyclists interested in track cycling.

wow_evidence: The Pacific Northwest's only indoor velodrome (one of three in Canada), 200 m wooden track, explicit out-of-town rider policy — riding it is day-shaping for a touring cyclist.
blurb: Indoor 200 m wooden velodrome — the only one in the Pacific Northwest.
